'''Transgenic Sample Eleven''' was the name given by [[Sannus Lorrick]] to a [[Vorantikus]] that he infected with [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] during his experiments on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. In [[3639 BBY]] a strike team [[Mission to the Lost Island|stormed]] Lorrick's [[Lost Island|lab]] and neutralized all threats within, including the Transgenic Sample Eleven.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Transgenic Sample Eleven appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during the flashpoint "Lost Island".
